fields.name: profile_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Recomputed on every profile write from the whole-sector word sum; see checksums[0].
fields.evidence: Algebraic derivation from FUN_08069194 matches both samples exactly via verify_checksum.py (see SAVE-FORMAT-REPORT.md section 4.3).

fields.name: generation_counter
fields.update_mechanism: psVar5[1] = (short)*piVar1, where piVar1 is incremented/clamped against a ROM ceiling constant each write.
fields.evidence: ghidra/decompiled.c:7107-7119; byte delta between the two samples is exactly +1.

fields.name: save_time_or_seed_u32
fields.update_mechanism: Copied verbatim from an unresolved RAM global (_DAT_08069238) at save time.
fields.evidence: Magnitude too large for a frame counter over the ~3.5s capture gap; plausibly a hardware timer/cycle count or RNG seed. Semantic meaning unproven.

fields.name: save_data_version_magic
fields.update_mechanism: Fixed ROM-constant string copied via FUN_080241fc on every write.
fields.evidence: FUN_080241fc copy length (0x20) and buffer offset (+8) match the exact byte range and content in both samples.

fields.name: opaque_block_1_unk_fields
fields.update_mechanism: 6 sub-fields (sizes 0x2c8,0x310,0x2c8,0xe80,0x3a0,0xc0) serialized in order via func_0x08069904.
fields.evidence: ghidra/save_related_functions.c lines 219-261; field sizes confirmed, contents never observed non-zero.

fields.name: flag_array_a

observed_values.both samples: repeating 00 00 00 00 / 01 00 00 00 dword pattern, 81 active bytes from offset 0x1bca

fields.update_mechanism: Sequential field within FUN_080674e8's 22 sub-field list.
fields.evidence: Reconstructed cursor offset (0x1bca) is an EXACT match to the observed active-range start in saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt; field semantics (likely a u32 flag/unlock table) are unproven.

fields.name: flag_array_b
fields.update_mechanism: Sequential field within FUN_080674e8's 22 sub-field list.
fields.evidence: Reconstructed cursor offset (0x1ffb) is an EXACT match to the observed active-range start; likely a progress/completion bitfield.

fields.name: sentinel_array

observed_values.both samples: mostly 0xff with a trailing 0x0c byte around offset 0x212b

fields.update_mechanism: Single large field, size 0x294, serialized via FUN_0805e6d0.
fields.evidence: Field boundaries match code; 0xff-sentinel pattern is a classic empty-slot marker for an item/monster list, but unproven. Observed active sub-range 0x20b2-0x212f falls entirely inside this field.

fields.name: u32_field_at_0x2313
fields.update_mechanism: First of 13 sequential sub-fields serialized by FUN_08013240.
fields.evidence: Reconstructed cursor offset (0x2313) is an EXACT match to the observed active-range start.

fields.name: u32_field_at_0x2720

observed_values.both samples: 2 active bytes within this field per hexdump

fields.evidence: Reconstructed cursor offset (0x2720) is an EXACT match to the observed active-range start.

fields.name: unidentified_tail_region

observed_values.both samples: active/non-zero per saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt, not individually examined

fields.update_mechanism: Not identified; lies beyond the reconstructed end of the 9 traced sub-serializer calls (cursor ends at offset 10137 / 0x2799).
fields.evidence: Open question; likely a sub-function outside the extracted 32-function seed set in ghidra/save_related_functions.c.

fields.name: sram_format_stamp_magic
fields.update_mechanism: Not traced to a specific writer instruction in this extraction; inferred to be written once at chip-format time.
fields.evidence: Exact byte match at absolute offset 0x7fe0-0x8000 in both samples; preceded by 0xff-filled unwritten space.
